profile: Voyager Therapeutics develops genetic medicines for neurological diseases. Its pipeline includes programs for Alzheimer’s disease, Friedreich’s ataxia, Parkinson’s disease and other central nervous system conditions. Its TRACER platform discovers adeno-associated virus capsids intended to deliver therapies to the brain. The company advances proprietary drug candidates and partnered programs with collaborators, and develops a non-viral delivery platform for neurological therapeutics.
